title: Figure 5 — rare QTL variants at disease genes
overview: Rebuild the five current Figure 5 panels from the accepted aggregate data. A shows rare-variant counts and ClinVar classes; B shows ClinVar coverage; C shows the selection funnel and pathogenic enrichment; D and E show posterior effects for nine genes with current REM labels. Build the stacked R layout, then display the exact November 2, 2026 submission image. The historical ACVRL1 and SPR main panels belong to the supplement and are not used here.
notes: The panel map follows scripts/prepare_data_s1.R and the current Science print export. No controlled participant records are printed or copied.
The plot code follows output/figure5_combined_draft/build_science_panels.R and build_panel_A_v21.R. All output files go through the shared output helper.

Panel A assigns each variant to the population with its maximum allele frequency. AD totals 1,480 variants; AR totals 3,074 variants. Classes use the accepted precedence P/LP, then VUS, then B/LB, with missing classifications called unannotated.

Panel B gives EUR priority when EUR allele frequency is at least 75% of the maximum across the six populations. Its population denominators can differ from panel A. The notebook checks the saved pooled non-EUR versus EUR Fisher tests from aggregate counts.

Panel C uses the verified counts 2,928, 526, and 230, with 560, 375, and 186 AR genes. Enrichment is the stage P/LP proportion divided by the starting P/LP proportion. The final nine-gene endpoint permits either effect direction and requires distinct reference and candidate variants. It is not another decreasing-effect filter.

Panels D and E retain all 14 and 16 saved effects. Their source tables contain four REM labels, including ASJ [REM]. The values are posterior mean QTL effects, not log2 aFC. Some benign comparators are common. PMM2 includes different molecular assays.
The R composition follows the archived 184 x 225 mm panel positions and left-pointing links. The final show_reference(5) cell displays the exact submission image separately.
limitations: This notebook repeats plotting and checks the saved aggregate tests. It does not rerun fine mapping, ClinGen curation, ClinVar annotation, population assignment, or variant selection.

The R layout is a reconstruction. Font metrics, text positions, endpoint label alignment, and the funnel frame can differ from the archived SVG. Only the final submission-reference cell shows the exact accepted layout.
Effect signs alone do not establish pathogenicity. Effect magnitudes from different molecular assays are not directly comparable.
